hypotheses.reasoning: A malformed message, msg-798041 (partition 10, offset 269792), contains a null byte and fails JSON parsing every time. It gets nacked and redelivered over and over (attempt 24+) because no max-retries is set. That blocks partition 10, so its lag climbs from 996 to 8208 messages while CPU stays normal. order-service then times out waiting for downstream confirmations, which is a symptom of the blocked consumer. The GC pause at #61 is a separate, earlier event.
With no max-retries or dead-letter queue configured, one bad message can stall the partition indefinitely. This is the reason the impact is so large, but the bad message is what set it off.

verdict.recommendedAction: Skip or dead-letter msg-798041 at offset 269792 on partition 10 so the consumer can move past it. Add a max-retries limit and a dead-letter queue to order-consumer. Find out which producer wrote the payload containing a null byte. Re-check the orders that order-service marked failed.
